verses.text: A Psalm of David. I will sing of Your loving devotion and justice; to You, O LORD, I will sing praises.

segments.text: A Psalm of David. I will sing of Your loving devotion and justice; to You, O LORD, I will sing praises.

verses.text: I will ponder the way that is blameless—when will You come to me? I will walk in my house with integrity of heart.

segments.text: I will ponder the way that is blameless—when will You come to me? I will walk in my house with integrity of heart.

verses.text: I will set no worthless thing before my eyes. I hate the work of those who fall away; it shall not cling to me.

segments.text: I will set no worthless thing before my eyes. I hate the work of those who fall away; it shall not cling to me.

verses.text: A perverse heart shall depart from me; I will know nothing of evil.

segments.text: A perverse heart shall depart from me; I will know nothing of evil.

verses.text: Whoever slanders his neighbor in secret, I will put to silence; the one with haughty eyes and a proud heart, I will not endure.

segments.text: Whoever slanders his neighbor in secret, I will put to silence; the one with haughty eyes and a proud heart, I will not endure.

verses.text: My eyes favor the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me; he who walks in the way of integrity shall minister to me.

segments.text: My eyes favor the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me; he who walks in the way of integrity shall minister to me.

verses.text: No one who practices deceit shall dwell in my house; no one who tells lies shall stand in my presence.

segments.text: No one who practices deceit shall dwell in my house; no one who tells lies shall stand in my presence.

verses.text: Every morning I will remove all the wicked of the land, that I may cut off every evildoer from the city of the LORD.

segments.text: Every morning I will remove all the wicked of the land, that I may cut off every evildoer from the city of the LORD.
